title: People, Clothing, and Weather
summary: Describing people, appearance, clothing, weather, and comparisons.
whyItMatters: Appearance, clothing, and weather vocabulary helps identify people, discuss what someone is wearing, and choose suitable clothes. Neutral observation plus precise adjectives is more useful than vague judgments.

mentalModel.title: Describe from stable to temporary
mentalModel.content: Start with general appearance, then clothing, then the current weather or situation.

mentalModel.title: Build noun packages
mentalModel.content: Learn clothing with article, plural, color, and a common verb: die Jacke, die Jacken, eine blaue Jacke, eine Jacke tragen.

mentalModel.title: Connect weather to clothing choice
mentalModel.content: Turn weather words into decisions: 'Es ist kalt, deshalb trage ich einen Mantel.'

ruleBlocks.title: Use neutral descriptive features
ruleBlocks.content: Describe observable features with 'sein' and 'haben': groß, klein, jung, lange Haare, eine Brille.

ruleBlocks.title: Use tragen for what someone is wearing
ruleBlocks.content: Say 'Sie trägt eine rote Jacke' and learn the clothing noun with its article.

ruleBlocks.title: Use fixed weather patterns
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Es ist warm/kalt/windig', 'Es regnet', and 'Die Sonne scheint'.

ruleBlocks.title: Link weather and clothing
ruleBlocks.content: Use simple reasons or consequences: 'Bei Regen brauche ich einen Regenschirm.'

sentenceStructure: Use 'sein' with adjectives and 'haben' with noun features.
Use 'tragen' with an accusative clothing object.
Adjective endings inside noun phrases are introduced through useful chunks here.

concepts: describe style, materials, and changing weather

comparisons.summary: The grammar lesson turns descriptive adjectives into comparisons.
The communication lesson organizes descriptions and appropriate reactions.

examples.de: Mara ist groß und hat lange dunkle Haare.
examples.en: Mara is tall and has long dark hair.

examples.de: Heute trägt sie eine grüne Jacke und schwarze Schuhe.
examples.en: Today she is wearing a green jacket and black shoes.

examples.de: Es regnet, deshalb nehme ich einen Regenschirm.
examples.en: It is raining, so I am taking an umbrella.

examples.de: Bei kaltem Wetter trage ich einen Mantel und einen Schal.
examples.en: In cold weather I wear a coat and scarf.

examples.de: Ist das der Mann mit der roten Mütze?
examples.en: Is that the man with the red hat?

commonMistakes.wrong: Sie hat eine Jacke an tragen.
commonMistakes.correct: Sie trägt eine Jacke. / Sie hat eine Jacke an.

specialCases: Descriptions of people should remain relevant and respectful.
'Anhaben' is common conversationally for wearing clothes.
Color and adjective endings vary with article, gender, and case and are expanded later.
tips: Describe people in photos using only observable details.
Learn every clothing noun with article and plural.

sourceStyle.origin: LangCompass editorial lesson aligned to the Momente A1.2 M4 catalog topic
sourceStyle.notes: The lesson prioritizes neutral description and practical weather-clothing connections.
